name: Tax season document checklist
audience: Salaried people and sole proprietors preparing documents before they file, or before they meet a tax practitioner.
summary: Track the documents a South African individual return usually asks you to find.
description: Tick what you have, what is missing, and what does not apply. The workbook counts each status. It does not calculate tax and it does not submit a return.
benefits: See how many documents are still missing
Keep the source of each document next to the line
Avoid starting a return with a half-finished folder
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
